title: Tensor power of a function
statement: For a function $g$ from a type $\Omega$ to the real numbers and a tuple $x=(x_1,\ldots,x_d)\in\Omega^d$, define its tensor power at $x$ to be $\prod_{i=1}^d g(x_i)$.
